title: Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛) is a story encounter in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley, found at The Axemaster's Fall. Beating it yields Dread Axe.

sections.title: Where to Find the Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛)
sections.content:
Location: The Axemaster's Fall.

Appears in: Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛)
sections.content:
What works

  • The axe swings are unblockable on the overhead - dodge, do not guard.
  • Break his guard with Sha-Chi attacks to take the Dread Axe.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 4 of 60 in the progression order, in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley. Before it: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute. After it: Hua, Deadly Betrothed (新娘阿花). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
